items.title: STERIS chooses Sanford for $600 million manufacturing campus
items.summary: The mystery behind “Project Sol” has been revealed. Global healthcare company STERIS will build a $600 million manufacturing, research and distribution campus in Sanford, bringing at least 335 jobs to Lee County in what local leaders say is the largest economic development project in the county’s history. items.summary: Medical equipment and services company Steris (NYSE:STE) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.3% year on year to $1.49 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.59 per share was 3.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
